critical_code_review_comments: safety_escalation_engine.py cleanly layered on safety_engine (Doc 43), workspace safety colors (Docs 49/51), guided (Doc 52), Homie urgent (Doc 54). Tier promotion logic (_tier_for) is deterministic: RED→hard_stop, ORANGE or electrical/plumbing checkpoint→critical_confirmation, YELLOW or any other checkpoint→caution_confirmation, else informational.

Override endpoint short-circuits correctly: RED/hard_stop 409 before reason validation so red conditions can never be silently overridden even with reason. Reason is trimmed and truncated to 400 chars — persisted on sa_overrides and pointer set on the assessment.
acknowledge endpoint refuses hard_stop with 409 even if confirmed=true — matches Doc 56 spec that RED must be resolved/rerouted, never dismissed.

urgent detection uses substring matches on lowercased text — 'I smell gas' hits gas pattern, 'smoke' hits fire, 'sparking'/'got shocked' hits electrical. Note: 'burning smell' (fire) also matches 'smell' in gas list if order mattered, but gas trigger requires 'smell gas' phrase, so no collision.

guided.tsx safetyGated computed derived from (checkpointDef && !checkpointDone) || (assessment && !acked && ack_tier in caution/critical) — gw-done disabled prop and label switch correctly bound. Voice runVoiceCommand.'done' respects the gate (line 137).
assessStep called on session start (line 78) and on every advance (line 115) — new step always re-assessed and gate state reset (line 47).
